description: We are ordinary schoolchildren who possess basic skills in information searching, coding, animation, and creating presentations, and we would like to take part in the challenge.
summary: We have created a website featuring engaging science-themed comics about space, fascinating experiments, and incredible human discoveries. Currently, the site hosts about six comics with compelling content, all based on information from NASA. Some comics can be unlocked using special codes found within the comics themselves. The goal of our project is to spark interest in science and space, while also building a truly unique resource filled with great content.
details:
1)Our project is a website featuring comics that contain scientific information.
2) Our website features a very simple interface, designed to help readers find comics as quickly as possible.
3)Once released, the project should encourage people to read and develop themselves—and, most importantly, to take an interest in space as a relatively new frontier for humanity.
4)ChatGPT helped us with some questions. We used Figma, HTML, VS Code, and Google Chrome.
5)In our opinion, our website is as creative as it can be, featuring a user-friendly interface, an engaging background, and cool comic-style buttons.
6)Our team took into account all the factors surrounding us—primarily what we observed among our peers.
